summary: Round 2 fixes most of the R1 problems: §2.2 now retracts the false `I(A:B|c) <= I(A:B)` claim and cleanly separates the two blockers, §5.1 is now agnostic and no longer names a trusted-relay fallback, and I did not find a reintroduced combined-chain or DPI-smuggling argument. Approach A and C remain framed as failure analyses rather than proofs. However, R1's INS1 issue is not fully closed because Approach D still states the joint/multi-edge formulation as if established, rather than keeping it clearly conjectural throughout.

That is the same structural thesis R1 required to be downgraded to speculation. Even though §3 renames INS1 to CONJ1 and adds caveats, this earlier conclusion reintroduces the overclaim outside the conjectural framing.
